outcome: Pelvimetric parameters (transverse diameter, obstetric conjugate, interspinous distance, sagittal midpelvis, intertuberous distance, sagittal outlet, posterior sagittal outlet)
cohort: 301 pregnant women at term who underwent MRI
finding: 3D MR pelvimetry was feasible for determining pelvic dimensions at term pregnancy in a Chinese population.
mod_finding: Using a previously described CT 3D pelvimetry method for predicting CPD, 67.6% (142/210) of women in the vaginal delivery group were diagnosed with CPD.
